acceptance_predicates.description: A test-only ControlServer and ControlClient fixture performs a bounded authenticated request/response against a deterministic credential-free backend without fabricating runner, provider, lease, or authority state.
The fixture exercises the existing live-service bootstrap, launch-factory and sandbox rejection/teardown branches needed by AR-1783, with positive and negative assertions and no production fallback.

A bounded delegated-isolation runner or equivalent fixture exercises the authenticated live launch path when the pinned native capability is available and records unavailable capability explicitly otherwise.
Serialized workspace coverage, focused tests, formatting and clippy are run through handoffctl; generated profiles and temporary artifacts are removed and the product tree is clean.
Tests retain no credentials, prompts, provider responses, private paths or fabricated authority and preserve all existing gates.

definition_of_done: The narrow cross-crate test fixture is reviewed and merged on a signed DCO commit.
Exact focused and serialized full-gate evidence is recorded durably.
AR-1783 remains in progress until its own acceptance and coverage gate are satisfied.

inputs.description: AR-1783 coverage evidence identifying the missing authenticated control/live-isolation seam.
The existing public ControlServer/ControlClient protocol and test-only backend interfaces.
Existing live_service, launch_factory and sandbox branches under test.

outputs.description: A bounded credential-free authenticated ControlClient/ControlServer test fixture and positive/negative tests.
Bounded delegated-isolation test evidence with explicit capability classification.
Exact focused/full test, coverage, cleanup and privacy evidence.

gates.description: Focused control/runtime fixture tests pass, including positive and hostile cases.
Serialized workspace coverage and native quality gates pass at their unchanged thresholds.
Exact-tree privacy and generated-artifact checks pass.
Independent exact-head review and signed DCO verification pass.
